title: muhlenbergia frondosa f. commutata
intro: Muhlenbergia frondosa f. commutata, commonly known as Deer Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Deer Grass are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to ease coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Muhlenbergia frondosa f. commutata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
